issues.description: The UML in the problem statement indicates the Lecture attributes are private ( '-' prefix in the UML), and the reference solution declares these attributes as private. However, the template Lecture.java pre-declares two attributes (lectureName and numberOfInscribedStudents) as public. This visibility mismatch between the template and the UML/solution can confuse students about the intended encapsulation (use of getters/setters) and may lead them to modify public fields directly instead of implementing private fields with accessors as specified.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the template Lecture.java to match the UML and the solution by removing or changing the pre-declared public fields to private declarations (or remove them and leave TODO placeholders). Ensure the template encourages implementing private attributes and the corresponding getters/setters so students follow the intended encapsulation design.
